title: Sunday family sync
transcript:
Dana: Okay, quick Sunday sync. Three things: flu shots, the internet bill, and the conferences.
Chris: Go.
Dana: Leo's flu shot is due in October. Brightwater does walk-in flu clinics on Saturdays in October. Can we just do all four of us at once?
Chris: Yes. October 10th works, we have nothing that morning. Say 10 to 11?
Dana: Saturday October 10, 10 to 11 am, Brightwater walk-in, all four of us. I'll put it on the calendar.
Chris: And Ava's EpiPen expires in February, right? Let's ask them for a new prescription while we're there.
Dana: Good call. Add that. Second thing, internet. The promo ends at the end of October and it jumps to 85 a month.
Chris: I'll call Brightline this week and ask if they'll extend the promo. If they won't, I'll look at other providers before November 1st.
Dana: Deadline Friday for the call?
Chris: Friday the 25th, yes.
Dana: Last thing, parent-teacher conferences are the week of October 26th and they're all minimum days, so Rosa needs to start early that week.
Chris: I'll tell Rosa by the end of next week. She starts 45 minutes before dismissal on those days, so 11:45.
Dana: Great. And the HVAC filter, I think we're overdue. It's the 16x25x1.
Chris: I'll order two today so we have a spare.
Dana: Decided, then. Flu shots on the 10th, Chris calls Brightline by Friday, Chris tells Rosa about conference week, Chris orders filters. I'll book the flu clinic slot and ask about the EpiPen.
Chris: Sounds good.
